definition.name: NXspm_piezo_sensor
definition.doc: A position sensor of the piezo scanner. It reports the position of the tip relative to the sample, as given by the extension of the scanner piezos, along the axes of the frame named by ``depends_on`` (the :ref:`scanner_frame </NXspm/ENTRY/scanner_frame-group>` in NXspm). A group may describe all three axes or a single axis (e.g. the height, or ``z``, piezo sensor).

field.name: depends_on
field.doc: The frame in which ``x``, ``y``, ``z`` and the ``AXISoffset_value`` fields are given. Points to an :ref:`NXcoordinate_system` (the :ref:`scanner_frame </NXspm/ENTRY/scanner_frame-group>` in NXspm).

field.name: x
field.doc: The position of the tip relative to the sample along ``x`` of the frame given by ``depends_on`` (e.g. a target or averaged target value).

field.name: y
field.doc: The position of the tip relative to the sample along ``y`` of the frame given by ``depends_on`` (e.g. a target or averaged target value).

field.name: z
field.doc: The position of the tip relative to the sample along ``z`` of the frame given by ``depends_on`` (e.g. a target or averaged target value). In the scanner frame, ``z`` points from the sample towards the probe, so a vendor value that increases as the tip approaches the sample must be stored with the opposite sign.

field.name: AXISoffset_value
field.doc: The offset that is added to the measured value along the AXIS axis of the frame given by ``depends_on``. AXIS denotes the ``x``, ``y`` or ``z`` axis (e.g. ``x_offset_value``).

group.name: piezo_configuration
group.doc: The piezo configuration information like piezoelectric calibration and material properties.
The positioner information like the position of the tip, the position of the sample, PID controller etc.

group.name: piezo_material
group.doc: The material description and properties of the piezoelectric scanner materials.
